{{Hatnote|For the era article, see [[Virtual Modern]]. These hubs are distinct from the 2002&ndash;2009 titles on [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]. Full constructed pool: [[Open]].}}
'''Current Virtual Sets''' are the [[Players Committee]] Virtual Sets of the [[Virtual Modern]] era, from the [[2014 Virtual Card Pool Reset]] onward.<ref name="mp">[[Main Page#Virtual Modern (2014–)|Main Page]] Virtual Modern tiles</ref> Numbering starts at [[Virtual Set 0]] and [[Virtual Set D]] (24 September 2014), then a new sequence from [[Virtual Set 1]]. The full constructed pool is [[Open]].
